name: QT-KT
description: QT-KT, also known as Qutee-Kaytee and often referred to as Qutee, was an astromech droid and a member of D-Squad, under the command of Colonel Meebur Gascon, during the Clone Wars. She belonged to Jedi Knight Aayla Secura. She was upgraded by the Parwan Doctor Gubacher to have a controlled, hovering super magnet to use. Between 3 ABY and 4 ABY, during the Imperial Era, QT-KT rejoined the squad to assist her old companion, R2-D2, in his fight against the Scourge.
